blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Japan are pushing for regional cooperation to address oil supply disruptions, including coordinated oil releases, storage arrangements, and knowledge transfer among Asian countries. President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi raised the proposals during the 4th Asia Zero Emission Community (Azec) Summit on Tuesday, as part of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits hosted by the Philippines in Manila.
